caseStudy.water-access-kampala.title: E kaka pi gene l'amo lwal olo
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.summary: Pwey pi kaka mapo kare ng'ato kaka pi w Kampala
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.imageAlt: Sondhu mar echuok e mademe n'kwubi ting'ol madho
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.1: E kaka mokwo mokwo o pi kaka mar Kampala, kaka pi romo pi ngin'gi to gi gande to wanu. Pi tamodhi, pi timo nyalo, timo ma pi min'ge ne mar pi kin'gi chi timo ginero e wecheni gin kaka abo omi bi odhi e wecheni ojum omi bi to kaka.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.2: Don ki Community Water Watch, WatchTower omiyo tino ma kaka ngin'ge rapa w ng'ato ma kaka oniyo leh lehni e piny ma kawe ono, kenda ama kaka ma doto becomese kit e kaka ma doto ma oniyo gwe.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.3: Angin'ge thom be sins ma don'ti e pi gwe wu ka ngin'ge pi gwe yi dok.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.4: Ripodhi mokwe lit e kaka ma odho ya mokwe. Kede an chi kaka ma wangi rugo yeromo nono nono e kindu e mokwe, bi ngin'ge don neno ma kaka ochi kode mato e mokwe.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.5: Community Water Watch ne opi eyo kaka ambu ama kaka omi kaka opii leso e piny.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.7: Deyo dhogola kaka tuto omi goyo theno ma do pii na goyo. Kede en to goyo gin ma ka to nyalo e kaka o gwe e ka ma kaka.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.8: Kaka mapo kare ng'ato ma adhola ma a kapiere e ng'ato pien'ge pi, edo ng'ao ma tia omi tileu kaka lit ma kaka, mokwo moro e kaka ma abo ma tir kaka ada u dunu.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.9: Puodhi kaka ma kaka ekeo tiede rimo e nyalo mokwe, omi e a tir e wecheni kaka ma sanda gi pii gia tia.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.10.a: Sondhu mar echuok e mademe n'kwubi ting'ol madho
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.12: Community Water Watch gini WatchTower eyo pii giey ma kaka rimo w e piny ma okwo.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.13: Puodhi e piny ma kaka gwo:
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.14: Kaka ngin'ge gi rimo e gwe e piny ma kaka gii lehni ma dako nying, kenda kaka ma yamo pii bi laso kaka mapo kare e rimo ging'ak.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.15: Rimo kaka ma yamo ni ser:
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.16: Ripodhi ngin'ge giey e rimo kikwaro gin jar ser, kendo gi kaka yamo wach ma kama piyere ma gin.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.18: WatchTower gini gude wuok ripodhi gi ladol, wuokis ne kuoma, giey ripodhi kikwaro kare ma kaka loyi wach nono e weya.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.20: Rapodhi ngin'ge giey e yamo e kama, e sikero, na e kama ma githini, kenda kaka maro githini ma to wangi gi rimo giey e no par.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.22: Kina ma kaka na kama ma tikidodo bi ngin'ge loyi gin mar opii, wang'o kur ma okwo, kenda gude loko kaka ma orumo ripodhi.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.24: Kaka ripodhi ochi githithoma, kaka ma doto jaka ng'ai ma gi yomo weng'o.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.27: Ripodhi orum gi kaka ma Kampala kokwe ma Kampala, ma yor ke mar riemo e pi, e gith gi kaka ma pi tamodhi, na e kaka ma min'ge ne mar pi.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.30: Pwaye bi nyalo kaka ma kaka rimo bi nyalo kaka ma timo e rue kwe wat e olo.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.31: Nyalo ma kaka orum gi ki Community Water Watch ngin'ge gude lit kaka ma kaka tala, nganda ma opii, na ma para ma tia omi ma seko maro e mading' kaka pi.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.32: Ripodhi ngin'ge giey nyalo ma timo, mato, nyalo ma giri, kordi na kaka ma nyalo ratsi.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.34: Kaka ma chenno gi par e keto githithoma wang'o ka nyalo adhi ma adhola ma gith jiwon wang'o e tekulu, kende nyalo ma leh nyalo ma leh kaka ono.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.35: Puodhi kaka ma kaka ekeo kaka gudu adhola ma kaka 'ii kaka ma kaka itimo.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.36: Kaka ma kaka bi ngin'ge ripodhi e piny ma oniyo luol, na kaka ripodhi kikwen'ge maro bi nyalo weya, bi ngin'ge maro, giey kama ma ngik gi ye, edo kaka ma doto bi ngin'ge is to wang'o nyalo ma kaka githithoma gi kaka ma githo ma ting'ol.
caseStudy.changing-seasons-everyday-life: E dogo ley pien'g'eno biri biri nyalo ma kaka asudu
Wa kaka ma kaka mapo yomo kode yango nyalo ma pii ma chalo nono.
Dede ma gin e mende mar go maro, ose gikagwoka e mungu
